image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on green vegetation. The wings are held open in a dorsal view, displaying a uniform dark brown color with distinct eyespots (ocelli) on both forewings and hindwings. The body is fuzzy and brown, positioned centrally between the wings. Two clubbed antennae are visible extending from the head.
